info.title: Thekra API
info.description:
Generated from the routes the server registers; summaries and shapes come from docs/api-notes.json (partial: endpoints without notes only list their path and method).

Live gateway: a WebSocket at `/ws` (same session cookie). Frames (JSON, `t` = type). Client to server: `ping`, `join {circle}`, `visible {on}`, `send {circle, body, client_msg_id, reply_to?}`, `read {circle, seq}`, `typing {circle, on}`, `sync {circle, after_seq | after_rev}`. Server to client: `hello {circles}`, `pong`, `ack {client_msg_id, id, seq, duplicate}`, `err {error, client_msg_id?}`, `msg`, `update`, `changed`, `receipt`, `pins`, `typing`, `sync {messages, more}`. The socket only makes things faster: every screen still works through the HTTP endpoints.

get.summary: Liveness for a load balancer or uptime check. No auth, no data.

post.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS to a phone number (creates nothing yet).

lang.description: string: ar | en, language of the SMS

newUser.description: boolean: this number has no account yet (the next step then needs a name)

devCode.description: string: the code, ONLY in development

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_phone, too_many_requests, sms_blocked, sms_unavailable, sms_failed

post.summary: Check the SMS code. Starts a session (cookie), or asks for the two-step PIN.

name.description: string: required for a new account

needPin.description: boolean: the account has a PIN; no session yet

ticket.description: string: present with needPin, valid 5 minutes, use it on /api/auth/pin

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_phone, code_expired, wrong_code, name_required

post.summary: Second step of sign-in: the 6-digit PIN. Starts the session. 5 wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: code_expired, wrong_pin, pin_locked

post.summary: Start the 7-day wait after which the SMS code alone signs in and the PIN is cleared.

resetAt.description: integer: when the wait ends (ms since epoch)

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: code_expired

post.summary: Change phone number, step 1: a code goes to the NEW number.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_phone, same_phone, phone_taken, too_many_requests, sms_blocked

post.summary: Change phone number, step 2: confirm with the code. The account, circles and history stay.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_phone, phone_taken, code_expired, wrong_code

post.summary: Turn on or change two-step verification (6-digit PIN). Changing needs the current PIN.

current.description: string: required when a PIN already exists

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_pin, wrong_pin, pin_locked

post.summary: Turn two-step verification off (needs the PIN).

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: wrong_pin, pin_locked

has_pin.description: integer: 1 when two-step verification is on

patch.summary: Change name, language, read receipts, push preview.

get.summary: The chat list: circles, groups and one-to-one chats with last message, unread count and personal settings.

post.summary: Create a family circle (with the agent) or a plain group.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: name_required

post.summary: Open (or create) a one-to-one chat with a registered person by phone number.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_phone, user_not_found, too_many_requests

post.summary: Join a circle with its invite code.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: too_many_requests

get.summary: One circle: members (with delivered/read marks), settings, last sequence number.
Messages. Sync by sequence (`after_seq`) or by revision (`after_rev`, also returns edits and deletions); pages are oldest-first.

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description: integer: messages with seq greater than this

parameters.name: after_rev
parameters.description: integer: messages whose revision is greater than this

post.summary: Send a text message. Idempotent by `client_msg_id`: a retry returns 200 with the same id.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: empty, blocked, not_found

post.summary: Upload photos, video or documents (multipart). The server decides the type by the bytes.
Create an album (managers of a family circle): the place for photos and voices kept from an old chat.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: forbidden, name_required, not_a_circle, archive_readonly

get.summary: The circle's albums with, for each, how many photos, voices and videos per year.

post.summary: Add one file to an album (multipart: file, optional thumb, takenAt 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' as in the original chat, sender, w, h). Photos, voice recordings and videos only, judged by their bytes. Sending the same file again returns duplicate:true.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: forbidden, invalid_attachment, invalid_date, attachment_too_large, storage_full, archive_readonly, too_many_requests

get.summary: Items of an album, oldest first, a page at a time.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: integer: item id to continue after

get.summary: The file of an album item (voices play inline, Range supported); `thumb=1` gives the small preview of a photo or video.

delete.summary: Remove one item from its album (managers).
Remove a whole album and its files (managers).

post.summary: Write a sealed letter (text, voice, video or photo) opened on a date, an occasion or after the author's death (event and death need the agent on).

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: agent_required, occasion_required, too_many_requests

get.summary: What the family sees: how many letters are waiting and how far the agent is from concluding, never titles or content.
Download your data in an open format (zip).
The yearly family book as a printable page.

post.summary: Mark messages read up to a sequence number.
React with one of the allowed emoji.

patch.summary: Edit your own text message (15 minutes).

delete.summary: Delete for everyone (member 48 hours, manager 7 days; an opened sealed letter only by its author).

get.summary: The agent's archive across all your family circles, newest first.
Reports sent by members, open first. The only place staff see message text (of reported messages); each look is written to the audit log.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: forbidden, admin_requires_pin

post.summary: Older single action: resolve (dismiss) a report with a note.

A moderator's decision on a report: dismiss, warn, remove_message, suspend_user, ban, escalate. suspend_user and ban also need the user-moderation permission. Sealed letters cannot be removed by moderation.

action.description: string: dismiss | warn | remove_message | suspend_user | ban | escalate

days.description: integer: for suspend_user; omit for until lifted

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_action, not_found, already_resolved, message_gone, sealed_protected, user_gone, not_yourself, forbidden

get.summary: Latency percentiles, counters and live connections of THIS node. No content, no names.
The audit log of staff actions, newest first. Append-only. Never holds message text or a full phone number.
Find people. By name, or by the last 4+ digits of a phone number. Numbers are always masked here.
One person's account facts (no message content). `reveal=1` shows the full number, needs the reveal permission, and is audited.

parameters.name: reveal
parameters.description: string: 1 to show the full phone number

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: not_found, forbidden

post.summary: Suspend a person (sessions end at once; no sign-in, no live connection). With `days` it lifts itself.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: not_found, not_yourself, forbidden

get.summary: The people with an admin role.

post.summary: Give or take a staff role. Owner only. The last owner cannot be removed.

role.description: string | null: owner | moderator | support, or null to remove

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: invalid_role, not_found, last_owner

get.summary: Usage without content: 30 daily series (sign-ups, active people, messages, new circles), weekly and monthly users, retention (day 1, 7, 30; only since activity tracking began), sealed-letter counts by status.

SMS operations (owner): provider, daily cap and use today, blocked calling codes, and per country (last 14 days) sent, failed, blocked, capped, verified and the completion rate. Only calling codes are stored, never numbers.

post.summary: Replace the list of blocked country calling codes (owner). Blocked countries get no code. Audited.

codes.description: array: calling codes such as 966, up to 4 digits each

get.summary: Platform switches (owner): signups_open, agent_enabled, sealed_enabled, with their current value and what they do.

default.description: boolean

post.summary: Turn a platform switch on or off (owner). Audited.

default.description: Error. `error` is one of: not_found, invalid_value
